title: Ilaaliyeyaasha Goosashada Qarsoon
intro: Dhul cagaaran, koox shakhsiyaad ah ayaa qorshe qarsoodi ah ku sameeyay mugdiga. Waxay wadaageen ujeedo guud, laakiin ujeeddadoodu aad bay uga fogayd mid sax ah. Wax yar ayay ka warqabeen in leexasho rabbaani ah ay sugaysay markay hurdeen.
clues: Waxaan go'aan adag gaarnay, annagoo u maleynay in qorshaheennu aanu cillad lahayn.
Waxaan damacsaneynay inaan dibadda u baxno goor hore, ka hor inta aysan kuwa kale xitaa kicin.
Waxaan ku dhaqaaqnay dhul barwaaqo ah, annagoo ku kalsoon sahaydeenna.
Markii aan gaarnay meeshii aan u soconnay, waxaan aragnay meel cidlo ah oo cidlo ah, sidaas darteed waxaan u maleynay inaan lunnay jidkii aan u soconnay.
Markaas ayaan ogaanay inay runtii tahay meeshii aan joognay, waanan quusannay, annagoo isku eedeynayna khasaaraha na soo gaaray.
Waxaan subaxdii dhaaranay inaan masaakiinta ka reebno goosashadayada, laakiin ciqaabtii Alle ayaa nagu soo dhacday annagoo hurda, taasoo beertayada ka dhigtay mid burbursan.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
